Pakistan offers bounty on Masood Azhar ahead of FATF review

Pakistan has announced a bounty of ₹7 million (approximately $25,000 USD) on Jaish-e-Mohammed chief Masood Azhar. The announcement was made ahead of a Financial Action Task Force (FATF) plenary meeting scheduled for October. Pakistan aims to avoid being placed back on the FATF's grey list. Azhar is linked to the Pathankot and Pulwama attacks.
